webster.text: Opposition in fact, essence, quality or principle; repugnance.

more.text: Inconsistency; quality or position destructive of its opposite.

example.quote: If there be this contrariety of opinions in this house, what contrariety may not be expected, when we take into view thirteen conventions equally or more numerous !
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 24, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
